decision: New general AUTHOR duties explicitly allow fresh examples, selected mathematical cases, bounded local calculations/code and public primary-source reading within the original scientific targets. These are authorized research tools, not violations or automatic STOP triggers. Owner addendum2 prospectively supersedes older administrative scientific-execution bans; the prior written-only method choice is not imposed on these new author duties.
unchanged: Already frozen WRITTEN_ONLY review duties retain their scoped method contracts. All actual historical held outputs and their method/selection/proof/confidence consumers remain NONINPUT. Nothing here rehabilitates f337/f340 or any parent held episode, backdates permission, certifies innocence or waives factual disclosure.
resources: Keep local experiments small and non-disruptive. No heavy/paid/remote jobs, provider or credentials changes, new dependency installation, deletion, external-model CLI, commit/push/publication or live infrastructure action. Return experiment code/inputs/results and exact limitations; no random success or solver approximate status is a proof.
verification: Every load-bearing claim still needs a disjoint check and parent disposition. Separate AUTHOR/HYPOTHESIS/NUMERICAL-EVIDENCE/PROOF and actual original target versus relaxations. Do not count files/jobs/admin artifacts as progress.
